raw_prompt: Implement an atomic financial ledger transaction with debit/credit balance invariance and idempotency check.

atomic.rationale: Atomicity is an ACID system invariant (all-or-nothing execution), not an entity or UI component.

financial ledger.rationale: Ledger is a core domain entity / aggregate root storing accounting records.

transaction.rationale: Transaction is a primary business entity representing a financial posting event.

debit/credit.rationale: Debits and credits are numeric entry attributes / posting line types on a transaction.

balance invariance.rationale: Debit sum must equal credit sum. A mathematical balance equation that must never be violated.

idempotency check.rationale: Deduplication mechanism preventing duplicate execution of identical client requests.

implement.rationale: Imperative directive keyword from user instruction.

REQ-EXP-02.title: Validate Debit Equal Credit Balance Invariance

REQ-DER-02.title: Disallow Negative Amount / Non-Zero Transfer Guard

REQ-INV-01.title: Atomic Database Transaction Rollback on Failure

forbidden_hallucinations: Generic search UI for balance invariance
